description: This file implements the re_pattern and re_pattern_list classes, providing methods for generating inclusion/exclusion masks, merging patterns, and comparing pattern lists, specifically for support of radio subcarrier and resource element patterns in a wireless communication context.

classes.name: re_pattern
classes.description: Represents a resource element pattern with methods to generate inclusion and exclusion masks based on subcarrier and resource block allocations.

classes.name: re_pattern_list
classes.description: Manages a list of re_pattern objects, allowing merging, comparison, and mask generation over multiple patterns.

methods.name: get_inclusion_mask
methods.description: Generates an inclusion mask for a given symbol based on resource block and subcarrier allocations.

methods.name: get_exclusion_mask
methods.description: Generates an exclusion mask for a given symbol, marking resource elements to exclude.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges a new pattern into the pattern list, combining overlapping patterns.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Compares two re_pattern_list objects for equality based on their inclusion masks.

methods.name: get_inclusion_mask (list)
methods.description: Aggregates inclusion masks from all patterns in the list for a specific symbol.

methods.name: get_inclusion_count
methods.description: Counts the number of resource elements included over a range of symbols, filtered by a resource block mask.

methods.name: get_exclusion_mask (list)
methods.description: Aggregates exclusion masks from all patterns in the list for a specific symbol.
